fulltext: IT之家 9 月 23 日消息，微软今天（9 月 23 日）面向 Windows 11 26H1 推送可选累积预览更新 KB5124006，用户安装后版本号升至 Build 28000.3086。
IT之家附上更新日志内容如下：
新增任务栏自定义选项，适配不同使用习惯，充分利用屏幕空间。
支持自定义任务栏屏幕位置：路径：设置 → 个性化 → 任务栏 → 任务栏行为，可将任务栏放置在底部、顶部、左侧、右侧。切换位置后，悬浮提示、菜单、动画效果会跟随任务栏；小图标、“永不合并任务栏按钮”等绝大多数个性化设置均可正常生效。
小型任务栏模式：适合小屏设备，最大化可用显示空间。开始菜单、搜索、系统托盘等组件会同步缩放，保证布局对齐统一。开启路径：设置 → 个性化 → 任务栏 → 任务栏行为 → 显示小型任务栏按钮；设置为“始终”即可缩小图标尺寸与任务栏高度。
任务栏设置页的「任务栏行为」分组默认展开，方便快速查找配置项。
提升非触控屏设备任务栏系统托盘区域的加载稳定性。
本次更新新增多项设置，优化开始菜单个性化体验：
在原有「自动（默认）」之外，新增小 / 大两种开始菜单布局。配置路径：设置 → 个性化 → 开始 → 开始菜单大小。
开始菜单以及系统设置页面内，原“推荐”板块正式更名为「最近」。
支持隐藏开始菜单内的用户名与头像。开关路径：设置 → 个性化 → 开始 → 在“开始”菜单隐藏我的姓名和个人资料图片。
为各个板块增加独立开关，可分别控制「固定」「最近」「所有应用」板块的显示或隐藏。
简化搜索主页面界面，减少视觉干扰，便于快速访问历史搜索记录。
优化搜索结果来源标识（区分应用、设置、本地文件、网页结果、微软商店内容），让用户清楚点击后跳转目标。
新增设置项：设置 → 隐私和安全性 → 搜索，可控制本地结果是否同步展示网页、微软商店建议内容。
Windows 将自动对高频访问文件夹建立索引，提升文件搜索命中率。可在「设置‑隐私和安全性‑搜索‑自动查找更多匹配位置」中管理该功能。
资源管理器主页加载速度提升，整体交互响应更流畅。
主页的精选内容轮播区域支持触摸滑动手势，浏览轮播文件更加便捷。
统一更新全系统进度条样式，覆盖开机、登录、重启、关机、系统更新等场景，界面风格更加现代统一。
使用工作 / 学校账户登录的用户，可直接在共享窗口查找并安装应用。可通过设置 → 系统 → 共享 → 在共享体验中显示建议应用控制该功能开关。
Windows11 全新平台安全功能，用于保护管理员账户，采用即时按需提权机制，保留完整管理员操作能力。该功能默认关闭；可在 Windows 安全中心的账户保护板块、Intune 的 OMA‑URI 配置或者组策略中启用，完整部署需要多步配置流程。
优化虚拟桌面之间切换动画，切换更加流畅迅速。
提升设置‑系统‑显示页面的浏览与交互稳定性。
修复关闭省电模式后，屏幕亮度设置无法保留的问题。
优化任务管理器中应用日志信息展示的稳定性。
Windows 安装阶段，若不需要额外键盘布局，现在可以直接跳过键盘选择步骤。
优化「入门」应用，新增「安装应用」「固定网站」「主题」页面，帮助用户完成设备个性化设置，了解系统新特性。
设备手动进入睡眠状态后，完成系统更新会自动回到睡眠状态，即便系统自动睡眠选项被设置为“永不”也可生效。
该版本支持通过 Windows 更新推送应用更新；兼容的应用可享受更智能调度、更精简的更新流程，底层依托 Windows 更新编排平台（UOP）实现。
支持具备管理员权限的 WinUI3 打包应用实现应用内购买，开发者可以借助微软统一商务平台提供付费购买能力。
面向企业组织：设备正式注册入网前即可完成可信设备识别，支持设备专属策略、企业设备自动注册，以及开箱体验（OOBE）阶段的深度自定义。
新增进程隔离能力。MXC 是一套轻量高速安全框架，面向 AI 编码智能体、模型生成代码这类业务负载。
平台层面新增智能体进程标签预览支持。授权组件可向进程 Token 写入不透明智能体标识符；Windows 会保护该标签，并自动向下传递给子进程。
除已有的混合密钥交换组外，用户现在可以将后量子加密算法 ML‑KEM 单独用于 TLS 密钥交换流程。
优化日语环境下，netsh wlan show wlanreport 命令输出内容的展示效果。
提升日语输入法文本输入可靠性，降低卡顿概率。
修复语音输入的自动标点、启动器相关设置无法保存的问题。
自 2026 年 8 月起，Windows11 24H2、25H2 将不再内置 WMIC 工具。全新安装系统中已经默认移除 WMIC，也不再作为按需功能（Feature on Demand）提供。本次变更仅针对 WMIC，底层 WMI 服务不受影响，仍可正常使用。
优化智能裁切（Intelligent Carveout）界面的无障碍访问与易用性，同时完善全部支持语言与地区的翻译质量。
修复文件历史记录无法向外置驱动器、网络位置备份 / 还原文件的问题；即便备份驱动器正常连接，系统也会错误弹出「重新连接驱动器」提示的故障已得到修复。

fulltext: IT之家 9 月 23 日消息，夏威夷时间 9 月 22 日 9 点（北京时间 9 月 23 日 3 点）召开的 2026 骁龙峰会上，高通公司宣布在其第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版芯片上，强化支持虚幻引擎 5（Unreal Engine 5）支持。
高通为了提升 AI 渲染、超级分辨率与帧生成效果，为第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版芯片的 Adreno GPU 配备了专用 Adreno Matrix Cores，并推出 Adreno Neural Fusion 技术。IT之家附上相关截图如下：
Adreno Neural Fusion 可以认为是适配第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版芯片的“DLSS 4”画质增强技术，在同一条图形渲染管线中整合神经网络处理、AI 超级分辨率和 AI 帧生成，目标是在提升画质和帧率的同时，降低渲染负载与功耗。
游戏不必始终以最高分辨率渲染，而是先以较低分辨率生成画面，再利用 AI 恢复细节、提升清晰度，并生成额外帧，从而兼顾画质与流畅度。
Adreno Neural Fusion 的硬件基础是 Adreno Matrix Cores，这是首次在 Adreno GPU 内加入面向 AI 计算的专用核心，用于直接运行图形相关的神经网络模型。
对于手游玩家而言，未来可以在搭载骁龙芯片的旗舰手机上，进一步增强 Nanite 虚拟化几何体、Lumen 全局光照、实时阴影以及高分辨率材质等特性。
高通称，Adreno Neural Fusion 已支持 Unity 和 Unreal Engine 5，开发者不必完全从零构建自己的 AI 超分辨率方案。
对虚幻引擎 5 游戏而言，在高通新款旗舰芯片上，可能带来三方面价值：
更高画质：在较低内部渲染分辨率下，尽量保持纹理、光照和几何细节。
更高帧率：通过 AI 超分辨率减少原生渲染压力，并利用帧生成提高视觉流畅度。
更低功耗：减少 GPU 像素处理和系统内存访问，延长移动游戏续航。
虚幻引擎 5（Unreal Engine 5，简称 UE5）是 Epic Games 开发的实时 3D 引擎，提供了一套完整工具，让开发者能够创建、渲染和交互式运行三维世界：从模型、材质、光照，到角色动画、物理、音频、人工智能和多人网络，都可以在同一个引擎中完成。

cards.title: Anthropic’s new Claude Opus 5.5 packs more brains for fewer bucks
cards.title_cn: Anthropic的新款Claude Opus 5.5以更少的钱包装更多的大脑
cards.summary: 【Anthropic】TL;DR Anthropic’s new Claude Opus 5.5 promises improved performance, accuracy, communication, and stronger safety safeguards. The model generates responses over 30% faster and costs roughly 40% less t…
fulltext: Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.

When it comes to AI, performance, accuracy, and pricing are the biggest considerations for power users. With Claude Opus 5, Anthropic achieved impressive results on the performance and accuracy fronts, but access to the model came at a premium. With the company’s latest model released today, that’s less of a concern.
Anthropic announced Claude Opus 5.5 today, and the new model promises not only better performance and accuracy, but also a roughly 40% reduction in running costs compared to Opus 5.
According to the company, the new model is the strongest-performing model it has tested to date. Of course, with that come concerns, which Anthropic says it is tackling with new safeguards.
For starters, the new model communicates better. Anthropic says this was a concern for users with Opus 5.

According to early testers, Opus 5.5 communicates more naturally, with its writing being clearer and easier to follow. Messages are much easier to parse at a glance, which, according to testers, is helpful during long working sessions. “Verbose, hard-to-follow output has been my biggest frustration with frontier models, and Claude Opus 5.5 fixes it. It writes like a good colleague, and follows our writing rules,” wrote a Ramp software engineer, while a principal engineer at the Chicago Trading Company wrote, “Its writing is easy to follow and more coherent than Opus 5’s.”

When it comes to performance, Opus 5.5 leads models like Fable 5.1, Opus 5, GPT-6 Astra, and GPT-5.6 Sol in benchmarks like agentic coding, knowledge work, multidisciplinary reasoning, computer use, and visual chart recognition. In benchmarks like business workflows and agentic scientific research, the new model ranked second, only behind GPT-6 Astra, all while generating output 30% faster than Opus 5.

Of course, benchmarks only tell part of the story, so Anthropic brought real-world receipts. According to the company, an early tester was able to audit and fix a 200,000-line codebase in under three hours. Opus 5 took over 20 hours and 2.5x as many tokens to complete the same task. Similarly, in a test that tasked the AI model with translating software from C into Rust, Opus 5.5 took 9.5 hours. Fable 5.1 took 12 hours to complete the same task.

Anthropic also shared examples of similar efficiency and intelligence gains from early testers at GitHub, Clio, Lovable, Quantum, Spotify, and more. The tester at GitHub found that the model solved more terminal tasks than Opus 5 in less than half the steps, while the tester at Spotify hyped the model for being able to complete tasks for cheaper and faster than previous models.

Elsewhere, Anthropic touted the model’s native classifier, which essentially screens every action before it runs. The model also reportedly has stronger defenses than predecessors. It reportedly matches or beats Opus 5 in mitigating prompt injection attacks in every setting, including coding, tool use, computer use, and web browsing. “On a benchmark run by the AI security firm Gray Swan, Opus 5.5 ties Fable 5.1 for the lowest prompt injection success rate of any model tested,” the company added.

Perhaps the biggest attraction here is that Anthropic isn’t charging you more for all the improvements. API pricing has dropped from $5 on Opus 5 to $4 on Opus 5.5 per million input tokens. Similarly, pricing has dropped from $25 to $20 per million output tokens. Cache reads cost $0.20 per million tokens, down from $0.50, while cache writes cost $5 per million tokens, down from $6.25. According to the company, overall, with improvements in token efficiency, running Opus 5.5 will cost roughly 40% less than Opus 5 on typical workloads.

More importantly, you don’t really need to be a developer or use APIs to access Claude Opus 5.5. It is available to regular users too, with five-hour usage limits on Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans. Find more information, including detailed early tester testimonials, on Anthropic’s blog post, linked up top.

fulltext_cn: Android Authority上的会员链接可能会为我们赚取佣金。了解详情。
2026年9月22日—美国东部时间下午4:52
在人工智能方面，性能、准确性和定价是高级用户最大的考虑因素。借助Claude Opus 5 ， Anthropic在性能和准确性方面取得了令人印象深刻的成果，但获得该模型的机会非常宝贵。随着该公司今天发布的最新车型，这不是一个令人担忧的问题。
Anthropic今天发布了Claude Opus 5.5 ，新型号不仅保证了更好的性能和准确性，而且与Opus 5相比，运行成本降低了约40 ％。
据该公司称，新车型是迄今为止测试过的性能最强的车型。当然，随之而来的是人们的担忧， Anthropic表示它正在通过新的保障措施来应对这些担忧。
对于初学者来说，新模型可以更好地沟通。Anthropic表示，这是Opus 5用户关注的问题。

根据早期测试人员的说法， Opus 5.5的沟通更自然，其文字更清晰，更容易理解。消息更容易一目了然，根据测试人员的说法，这在长时间的工作会话中很有帮助。“冗长、难以遵循的输出是我对前沿模型最大的挫败感， Claude Opus 5.5修复了它。它像一个好同事一样写作，并遵循我们的写作规则， ”一位Ramp软件工程师写道，而芝加哥贸易公司的一位首席工程师写道，“它的写作很容易理解，比Opus 5的作品更连贯。”
在性能方面， Opus 5.5在代理编码、知识工作、多学科推理、计算机使用和视觉图表识别等基准方面领先于Fable 5.1、Opus 5、GPT-6 Astra和GPT-5.6 Sol等模型。在业务工作流程和代理科学研究等基准中，新模型排名第二，仅次于GPT-6 Astra ，同时产生的产出比Opus 5快30%。
当然，基准测试只能说明部分故事，因此Anthropic带来了真实世界的收据。据该公司称，早期的测试人员能够在三小时内审核并修复20万行代码库。Opus 5花了20多个小时和2.5倍的代币来完成相同的任务。同样，在让人工智能模型将软件从C翻译成Rust的测试中， Opus 5.5花了9.5个小时。寓言5.1花了12个小时才完成同样的任务。
Anthropic还分享了GitHub、Clio、Lovable、Quantum、Spotify等早期测试人员的类似效率和智能提升的例子。GitHub的测试人员发现，该模型在不到一半的步骤中解决了比Opus 5更多的终端任务，而Spotify的测试人员大肆宣传该模型能够以比以前的模型更便宜、更快的速度完成任务。

在其他地方， Anthropic吹捧了模型的原生分类器，它本质上是在运行之前筛选每个动作。据报道，该型号还具有比前辈更强的防御能力。据报道，它在减轻各种环境中的提示注入攻击方面与Opus 5相匹配或优于Opus 5 ，包括编码、工具使用、计算机使用和网页浏览。该公司补充说： “在人工智能安全公司Gray Swan运行的基准测试中， Opus 5.5与Fable 5.1并列，获得了所有测试模型中最低的即时注入成功率。”

也许这里最大的吸引力在于， Anthropic并没有为所有改进向您收取更多费用。API定价已从Opus 5的5美元降至Opus 5.5每百万个输入代币的4美元。同样，每百万个输出代币的定价从25美元降至2000美元。缓存读取成本为每百万令牌0.20美元，低于0.50美元，而缓存写入成本为每百万令牌5美元，低于6.25美元。根据该公司的说法，总体而言，随着代币效率的提高，在典型工作负载上运行Opus 5.5的成本将比Opus 5低约40 ％。
更重要的是，您无需成为开发人员或使用API访问Claude Opus 5.5。它也适用于普通用户，基于Pro、Max、Team和座位的企业版套餐有五小时的使用限制。在顶部链接的Anthropic博客文章中查找更多信息，包括详细的早期测试人员推荐。

cards.title: Rabbit’s new AI agent doesn’t need an R1 to run
cards.title_cn: Rabbit的新AI agent不需要R1就可以运行
cards.summary: 【The Verge】Rabbit, the company behind the underwhelming R1 device, is rolling out a standalone AI agent that you don't need its hardware to use, as reported earlier by Wired. The startup says its new OS3 "agenti…
fulltext: The startup’s AI agent can operate locally across Windows, Mac, and Linux devices.

Rabbit, the company behind the underwhelming R1 device, is rolling out a standalone AI agent that you don’t need its hardware to use, as reported earlier by Wired. The startup says its new OS3 “agentic operating system” runs in the cloud but operates locally across Windows, Mac, and Linux devices.

According to Rabbit, you can add up to five devices to one account, along with your preferred AI models. OS3 will automatically determine the devices, files, apps, and AI models it needs to complete a task. You can also access OS3 through its dedicated desktop site, a paired messaging app like Telegram or iMessage, as well as on Rabbit’s R1 device.

Though Rabbit founder Jesse Lyu tells Wired that the startup has stopped manufacturing R1 devices, it isn’t giving up on AI hardware entirely. It’s instead focusing on a new vibe-coding “cyberdeck” that will run OS3 when it launches within “months,” Wired reports.

Rabbit claims its OS3 system won’t store, copy, use, or sell your data. It notes that it will still keep your chats and memories stemming from them on its servers. Other AI providers linked to OS3 will also handle your data under their own privacy rules.

Early adopters of Meta’s Muse have been speculating that the reason the AI works so well is because it’s OpenClaw under the hood, wrapped in a more consumer-friendly package. Meta now says those comparisons aren’t entirely off-base. According to an X post by Nat Friedman, head of product at Meta’s Superintelligence Labs (MSL), Muse was “definitely heavily inspired as a product by OpenClaw.”
However, he clarified that Muse itself was “built from scratch.”

Friedman, the former GitHub CEO who joined Meta last year alongside Meta’s Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang, said that the team at Meta had fallen in love with OpenClaw and wanted Muse to be “something like OpenClaw” that could be scaled to billions of people.

Because OpenClaw is an open source project, it wouldn’t be surprising that Meta looked to it for inspiration, especially given its breakout success, which prompted OpenAI to snatch up its creator earlier this year. However, it speaks to Meta’s well-known playbook that involves taking promising products, then copying their best features — something it did most notoriously with Snapchat’s invention of the stories format.
Friedman’s statement on X was made in response to a post that had gone viral among the AI crowd, where Ansh Nanda, an AI app co-founder, claimed that “Muse is LITERALLY OpenClaw for normies.”

Nanda’s X post had included a conversation with Muse, where the AI agent said that the similarity between its own system files and those belonging to OpenClaw was not just “a coincidence” but rather “a match.”

Soon, this thread (and X more broadly) began blowing up as others shared their own comparisons and findings. For instance, one person pointed out that Muse also had a SOUL.md file, the plain text configuration file (written in a simple formatting language called Markdown) that defines an AI agent’s personality, communication style and tone, values, behavioral boundaries, and expertise.
A third noted that the files weren’t just named the same between the two assistants; their content was almost entirely the same.

“We built Muse from scratch, but it is definitely heavily inspired as a product by OpenClaw. After I used OpenClaw in January, I bought hundreds of Mac minis for the MSL team, and lots of us fell in love with using OpenClaw (and other personal agents), Friedman said on X. (TechCrunch has corrected Friedman’s punctuation for readability.)

“@steipete [Peter Steinberger] is a genius, and his harness was pioneering from the jump. I think a lot of people were inspired by it. Our goal with Muse was to build something like OpenClaw that we could make safe and secure and easy to use and scale to billions of people,” he wrote.

The Muse app has been something of a hit so far, having recently hit No. 1 on the U.S. App Store. Data indicates that it’s now outpacing ChatGPT’s launch when the platforms and market availability are compared directly.
Reached for comment, a Meta spokesperson pointed to Friedman’s statement, saying the company had nothing more to add beyond that.

Meta的Muse的早期采用者一直在猜测， AI之所以运作良好，是因为它是OpenClaw ，包裹在一个更适合消费者的包装中。Meta现在表示，这些比较并非完全脱离基础。根据Meta超级智能实验室（ MSL ）产品负责人纳特·弗里德曼（ Nat Friedman ）的X帖子， Muse “作为OpenClaw的产品，绝对受到了很大的启发。”
然而，他澄清说， Muse本身是“从零开始建造的”。
去年与Meta首席人工智能官Alexandr Wang一起加入Meta的前GitHub首席执行官Friedman表示， Meta的团队已经爱上了OpenClaw ，并希望Muse成为“类似于OpenClaw的东西” ，可以扩展到数十亿人。
由于OpenClaw是一个开源项目， Meta从中寻找灵感也就不足为奇了，特别是考虑到它的突破性成功，这促使OpenAI在今年早些时候抢走了它的创造者。然而，它谈到了Meta众所周知的剧本，其中包括采用有前途的产品，然后复制它们的最佳功能—这是Snapchat发明的故事格式中最臭名昭著的。
弗里德曼关于X的声明是为了回应一篇在人工智能人群中传播的帖子，其中人工智能应用程序联合创始人安什·南达（ Ansh Nanda ）声称， “Muse实际上是规范的OpenClaw。”
Nanda的X帖子包括与Muse的对话，其中AI代理表示，其自己的系统文件与OpenClaw文件之间的相似性不仅仅是“巧合” ，而是“匹配”。
很快，随着其他人分享他们自己的比较和发现，这条线索（以及更广泛的X ）开始爆炸。例如，有人指出， Muse还有一个SOUL.md文件，即纯文本配置文件（用一种名为Markdown的简单格式语言编写） ，它定义了AI代理的个性、沟通风格和语气、价值观、行为界限和专业知识。
三分之一的人指出，这两个文件的名称不仅仅是两个助手之间的相同；它们的内容几乎完全相同。
“我们从头开始构建Muse ，但作为OpenClaw的产品，它的灵感肯定很大。弗里德曼在X上说，在1月份使用OpenClaw之后，我为MSL团队购买了数百台Mac mini ，我们很多人都爱上了使用OpenClaw （和其他个人代理）。（ TechCrunch已经纠正了弗里德曼的标点符号，以提高可读性。）
“@ steipete [Peter Steinberger]是一位天才，他的马具从跳跃中开创了先河。我认为很多人都受到了启发。我们与Muse的目标是建立像OpenClaw这样的东西，我们可以让它安全可靠、易于使用，并扩展到数十亿人。”他写道。
到目前为止， Muse应用程序一直很受欢迎，最近在美国App Store上排名第一。数据表明，当直接比较平台和市场可用性时，它现在超过了ChatGPT的推出。
Meta发言人发表评论时指出弗里德曼的声明，称该公司除此之外没有什么可补充的。

cards.title: Your smartwatch might be giving your workouts more credit than they deserve
cards.title_cn: 您的智能手表可能给您的锻炼带来了超出应有的荣誉
cards.summary: 【Android Authority】TL;DR A new study finds that popular smartwatches from Apple, Samsung, Garmin, and Fitbit substantially miscalculate calories burned during exercise. The higher your body fat percentage, the less accu…
fulltext: Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.

If you own a smartwatch, you know the satisfaction that comes after finishing a strenuous workout, glancing at your wrist, and seeing just how many calories you’ve burned. If your aim is to be in a calorie deficit and lose weight, that figure on the watch holds a lot of importance. However, a new study suggests that your smartwatch might not be giving you accurate readings, especially if you have a higher body fat percentage.

Smartwatches have become increasingly common, not just because of their health and fitness tracking prowess, but also because of their convenience. I use mine during every workout, and while previous reports about inaccuracies have made me err on the side of caution when interpreting the numbers my watch throws out, I still find myself looking at them after every workout regardless. Considering The Conversation’s new report on smartwatch inaccuracies, I might have to change that habit.

Researchers at Florida International University, using a Fitbit Sense 2, Garmin Forerunner 955, Samsung Galaxy Watch 5, and an Apple Watch Series 8, found that the wearables substantially miscalculated how many calories users burn during specific workouts.

For the study, the researchers recruited 58 adults and made them complete a standardized cycling session while wearing all of the above-mentioned devices at the same time (two on each wrist). As the subjects pedaled, the researchers measured their energy expenditure using a metabolic analyzer, which essentially captures and measures the gases a person inhales and exhales during exercise via a mask.
This is the most reliable way to measure calorie expenditure during a workout, and it gave the researchers an accurate figure to compare each smartwatch’s calorie estimates against.
The result? “All four watches demonstrated substantial error in measuring caloric expenditure,” reads the report.

Apple, Garmin, and Samsung reportedly all overestimated calorie expenditure. Apple was the least inaccurate of the bunch. Fitbit, on the other hand, produced data that wasn’t systematically positive or negative when compared to the median, but it occasionally produced wildly inaccurate results, including seven readings that exceeded the metabolic analyzer’s reading by 450%. These were treated as device errors.

That, however, wasn’t the most interesting observation. Researchers found that errors increased based on the participants’ body fat percentage. Essentially, the higher a person’s body fat percentage, the greater the error in calorie estimates. This was observed across all the tested wearables.

Errors ranged from 50% to 100%, and in some cases even more. So, for example, if the metabolic analyzer found an exercise to result in an energy expenditure of 100 calories, the wearables, when used by someone with a high body fat percentage, estimated calorie expenditures of 150 (50% more) and 200 (100% more).

This is particularly concerning, especially considering that people with higher body fat percentages may be among those most likely to rely on calorie expenditure estimates to track their weight-loss progress. According to the report, someone with a body fat percentage of 35% or higher who exercises for four hours in a week might be overestimating their calorie expenditure by roughly 1,200 to 2,400 calories.

The researchers couldn’t pinpoint why higher body fat percentages resulted in greater inaccuracies, especially since manufacturers keep their calorie-estimation algorithms proprietary. Users should take their wearable’s calorie estimates as just that: estimates.

cards.summary_cn: 【Android Authority】TL; DR一项新的研究发现，来自苹果、三星、Garmin和Fitbit的流行智能手表在很大程度上误算了运动过程中消耗的卡路里。您的体脂百分比越高，精确度就越低……
fulltext_cn: Android Authority上的会员链接可能会为我们赚取佣金。了解详情。
2026年9月22日—美国东部时间下午2:15
如果您拥有智能手表，您就会知道完成剧烈的锻炼，瞥一眼您的手腕，并看到您燃烧了多少卡路里后所带来的满足感。如果您的目标是卡路里不足和减肥，那么手表上的这个数字非常重要。然而，一项新的研究表明，您的智能手表可能无法为您提供准确的读数，特别是如果您的体脂百分比较高。
智能手表变得越来越普遍，不仅是因为它们的健康和健身追踪能力，还因为它们的便利性。我在每次锻炼时都会使用我的手表，虽然之前关于不准确的报道让我在解释我的手表抛出的数字时更加谨慎，但我仍然发现自己在每次锻炼后都会看着它们。考虑到The Conversation关于智能手表不准确的新报告，我可能不得不改变这种习惯。
佛罗里达国际大学的研究人员使用Fitbit Sense 2、Garmin Forerunner 955、三星Galaxy Watch 5和Apple Watch Series 8 ，发现可穿戴设备严重错误地计算了用户在特定锻炼期间消耗的卡路里。
在这项研究中，研究人员招募了58名成年人，让他们在同时佩戴上述所有设备（每个手腕上两个）的情况下完成标准化的自行车课程。当受试者踩踏时，研究人员使用代谢分析仪测量他们的能量消耗，代谢分析仪基本上捕获和测量人在运动过程中通过面罩吸入和呼出的气体。
这是在锻炼期间测量卡路里消耗的最可靠方法，它为研究人员提供了一个准确的数字，以比较每个智能手表的卡路里估计值。
报告指出： “这四款手表在测量卡路里消耗方面都显示出很大的误差。”
据报道，苹果、佳明和三星都高估了卡路里消耗。在这群人中，苹果是最不准确的。另一方面， Fitbit产生的数据与中位数相比并不是系统性的正面或负面，但它偶尔会产生非常不准确的结果，包括七个读数，比代谢分析仪的读数高出450%。这些被当作设备错误处理。
然而，这并不是最有趣的观察。研究人员发现，根据参与者的体脂百分比，错误会增加。从本质上讲，一个人的体脂百分比越高，卡路里估计的误差就越大。在所有测试的可穿戴设备中都观察到了这一点。
错误范围从50%到100%不等，在某些情况下甚至更多。因此，例如，如果代谢分析仪发现一项运动导致100卡路里的能量消耗，那么当身体脂肪百分比高的人使用可穿戴设备时，估计卡路里消耗为150卡路里（增加50 ％ ）和200卡路里（增加100 ％ ）。
这尤其令人担忧，特别是考虑到体脂百分比较高的人可能是最有可能依靠卡路里消耗估计来跟踪减肥进度的人。根据该报告，体脂百分比为35 ％或更高的人每周锻炼四小时可能高估了他们的卡路里消耗量约1,200至2,400卡路里。
研究人员无法确定为什么较高的体脂百分比导致更大的不准确性，特别是因为制造商将他们的卡路里估算算法保留为专有。用户应该将可穿戴设备的卡路里估算值视为：估算值。
感谢您成为我们社区的一员。发布前请阅读我们的评论政策。

cards.title: Trump says the US is officially renaming AI to ‘super intelligence’
cards.title_cn: 特朗普表示，美国正式将人工智能重新命名为“超级智能”
cards.summary: 【The Verge】In a speech Tuesday morning at the UN General Assembly, Donald Trump railed against Iran, "globalists," climate change, and transgender people while also claiming that the US is now "officially" renam…
fulltext: The president claims the word ‘artificial’ makes intelligence fake.

In a speech Tuesday morning at the UN General Assembly, Donald Trump railed against Iran, “globalists,” climate change, and transgender people while also claiming that the US is now “officially” renaming artificial intelligence to “super intelligence.” Oddly, this wasn’t one of the entries in the poll Trump posted a few days ago when he started on this tangent.
Why is he saying this at all? Because, according to Trump, the word artificial makes intelligence fake. Is that what makes it sound fake to you? I can think of a few other reasons.

Trump has previously decreed renaming the Gulf of Mexico, Lake Superior, the Kennedy Center, and Denali, with digital maps quickly switching the labels on landmarks for users in the US, but he says that with this, “Let’s see if I have any power. Maybe I do, and maybe I don’t, we’re gonna find out pretty soon.”
Here’s what Trump said:

The United States also totally rejects any attempt to construct a globalist scheme to control for the artificial intelligence being spoken of so much now. Here and after officially called “super intelligence,” changing the name, and that the use of the word artificial makes intelligence fake.

It makes it sound fake, and it is not fake. It’s actually amazing. But we have to be careful. In fact, it is exactly the opposite of what it purports. From this point forward, all of the United States documents, and hopefully the world’s, will be changed to use the much more accurate term, super as opposed to artificial. So it’s super intelligence. In other words, welcome to the new world of super intelligence — SI. That’s, uh, let’s see if that does. It sounds much better. It is much better, and it’s much more accurate. Let’s see if I have any power. Maybe I do, and maybe I don’t, we’re gonna find out pretty soon.

Super intelligence. Every major new technology brings challenges, and super intelligence is … no exception. Yet. the very same people who said we’ll all be dead in 12 years because of global warming — a name since reborn to climate change because the planet was cooling, not warming, and nobody was dead. These are the same people that are now saying that AI is going to kill us all, that robots are going to attack us, and that everything is going to be a total disaster.

Same group of people. This is the group that came up with the Russia, Russia, Russia hoax. Ukraine, Ukraine, Ukraine hoax. Climate change, open borders. Whoever wins AI, you have to remember this. And now I say, whoever wins … SI. Whoever wins super intelligence wins. That’s the group that wins. And we’re leading now over China by a lot and everyone else.

We’re going to keep it that way. We’re going to keep it very, very straight and very strong. I’m not going to stifle growth of something that will be bigger than the Industrial Revolution. Many say bigger than the Industrial Revolution or the internet itself. And we will be very careful, and that’s why we have a Department of Justice that … we’ve already used it having to do with this very subject, and used it very powerfully.

Everything worked out very well and very quickly, and other law enforcement bodies that will rein things in if we have to do that. But we will only encourage super intelligence. We’re going to encourage it, not rein it in. We’re going to watch it closely through the Department of Justice.

The United States leads the world in super intelligence and will continue to do so safely and responsibly. Americans have never been a nation that retreats from a frontier or shrinks from a challenge, no matter how great or how daunting that challenge may be. Freedom was not a gift that Americans won easily after 250 years, and it is not one that we will ever, ever, ever, ever surrender.

cards.summary_cn: 【The Verge】在周二上午的联合国大会上，唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）抨击伊朗、“全球主义者”、气候变化和变性人，同时还声称美国现在“正式”更名……
fulltext_cn: 总统声称“人工”这个词让情报变得虚假。
在周二上午的联合国大会上，唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）抨击伊朗、“全球主义者”、气候变化和变性人，同时还声称美国现在正在“正式”将人工智能重新命名为“超级智能”。“奇怪的是，这不是特朗普几天前开始这个切线时发布的民意调查中的一个条目。
他干嘛这么说？因为，根据特朗普的说法，人工智能这个词让智能变成了假的。这就是它听起来像假的吗？我可以想到其他几个原因。
特朗普此前曾下令将墨西哥湾、苏必利尔湖、肯尼迪中心和德纳利重新命名，数字地图可以快速为美国用户切换地标上的标签，但他这样说， “让我们看看我是否有任何权力。也许我会，也许我不会，我们很快就会发现。”
以下是特朗普所说的话：
美国也完全拒绝任何构建全球主义计划来控制现在所说的人工智能的企图。在这里和之后，官方称之为“超级智能” ，改变名称，并且人工智能这个词的使用使智能成为假的。
听起来像是假的，不是假的。这实际上是惊人的。但我们必须小心。事实上，这与它所宣称的恰恰相反。从这一点开始，所有的美国文件，希望是世界上的文件，都将被改为使用更准确的术语，超级而不是人为的。所以这是超级智能。换句话说，欢迎来到超级智能（ SI ）的新世界。那就是，呃，让我们看看能不能做到。听起来好多了。它要好得多，也要准确得多。让我们看看我是否有任何力量。也许我会，也许我不会，我们很快就会发现。
超级智能。每一项重大新技术都会带来挑战，超级智能也不例外。然而，正是这些人说我们将在12年内因全球变暖而死亡—这个名字自从重生气候变化以来，因为地球正在变冷，而不是变暖，而且没有人死亡。这些人现在正在说人工智能会杀死我们所有人，机器人会攻击我们，一切都将是一场彻底的灾难。
同一群人。这个组织想出了俄罗斯，俄罗斯，俄罗斯的骗局。乌克兰、乌克兰、乌克兰恶作剧。气候变化，开放边界。无论谁赢得了人工智能，你都必须记住这一点。现在我说，谁赢了…… SI。谁赢得了超级智能，谁就赢了。这就是获胜的群体。我们现在在中国和其他所有人中处于领先地位。
我们会保持这种状态。我们会保持非常非常的笔直和坚固。我不会扼杀比工业革命更大的东西的增长。许多人说，这比工业革命或互联网本身更重要。我们会非常小心，这就是为什么我们有一个司法部......我们已经将它用于这个主题，并且非常有力地使用它。
一切都进展得非常顺利，非常迅速，如果我们不得不这样做，其他执法机构也会控制局面。但我们只会鼓励超级智能。我们会鼓励它，而不是控制它。我们将通过司法部密切关注此事。
美国在超级情报方面处于世界领先地位，并将继续以安全和负责任的方式这样做。美国人从来都不是一个从边疆撤退或从挑战中退缩的国家，无论这一挑战多么伟大，多么艰巨。自由不是美国人在250年后轻易赢得的礼物，也不是我们永远不会投降的礼物。
